claims: The screened ps2sdk builder packs VIF commands as immediate | NUM<<16 | CMD<<24 | IRQ<<31. UNPACK immediate includes unsigned bit14, double-buffer bit15, address in 16-byte units; the UNPACK command combines mode, masked bit4 and 0x60.

The screened PCSX2 implementation treats encoded NUM zero as 256; VIF1 bit15 adds TOPS before forming a bounded VU byte address. Cycle fill/skip, masks and STMOD affect how data reaches VU memory, so a plausible raw XYZ run is not sufficient to define VIF output.

Live official OpenRouter compatibility documentation directs Python SDK clients to base_url https://openrouter.ai/api and documents the SDK’s /v1/systemone request suffix; this is documentation evidence, not a new successful application request.

Live Python response documentation defines Usage using input_tokens and output_tokens with extra=ignore and exposes raw_http_response on SystemOneResponse. Provider cost should be retained from the raw body where supplied rather than assuming typed Usage has a cost attribute.
